headline: Former additional secretary found dead at Officers Club in Dhaka
summary: A former additional secretary was discovered deceased at the Officers Club in Dhaka. Authorities have initiated an investigation into the incident.
details: A former additional secretary has been found dead at the Officers Club in Dhaka. The discovery has prompted an immediate response from law enforcement officials.
The individual, whose identity has not yet been fully disclosed, was a high-ranking government official. The incident occurred within the premises of the prestigious Officers Club.
Police have begun an investigation to determine the circumstances surrounding the death. Further details are expected as the inquiry progresses.
Authorities are currently examining the scene and interviewing potential witnesses. The cause of death remains unknown at this early stage of the investigation.

headline: Petrobangla recruits for 753 posts in 9th & 10th grade, apply online by Nov 17, 2026.
summary: The Bangladesh Oil, Gas & Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla) has announced a recruitment circular for 753 positions in 9th and 10th grades. Interested candidates can apply online through Teletalk or Petrobangla's website until November 17, 2026.
details: Bangladesh Oil, Gas & Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla) has published a recruitment circular for a total of 753 positions in the 9th and 10th grades. The application deadline for these posts is November 17, 2026.

Candidates must apply online either through the Teletalk website or Petrobangla's official website. Upon entering the website, applicants will find options for 'Advertisement', 'Instruction for Submitting Application', and radio buttons for 41 categories of posts.

Clicking on the 'Advertisement' radio button will lead to the application form. Applicants must fill in all necessary information, especially the fields marked with a red star, and provide their National ID (NID) or birth registration number.

Candidates are required to specify their preferred institutions from the list provided in the recruitment circular. Selection will be based on merit and preference, subject to the availability of vacant positions in the respective institutions. Once submitted, the preference order cannot be changed.

After completing the application form, a preview will be available. Applicants must upload a color photograph (300x300 pixels, JPG format, max 100 KB) and their signature (300x80 pixels, JPG format, max 60 KB) in the designated areas. Black and white photos are not acceptable.

All information provided in the application must be declared as correct and true. Any false or incorrect information, detected ineligibility, or adoption of irregularities at any stage may lead to the cancellation of the candidacy.
Upon successful submission, an Applicant's Copy with the photo and signature will be generated. This copy, containing a User ID, should be downloaded or printed and saved for future reference.

After submitting the application, candidates must pay the examination fee via two SMS messages from a Teletalk prepaid mobile number. The fee for 9th-grade positions is 669 BDT, and for 10th-grade positions, it is 558 BDT, as per the circular's instructions.

Confirmation of successful fee submission will be sent via return SMS. Information regarding the publication of admit cards will be communicated through the Teletalk and Petrobangla websites, as well as via SMS to the applicant's mobile number. For any issues with online application, contact numbers and email addresses are provided.
